content.comment_body: I need to monitor a [product_name] [article_no]. I wrote some software to read inputs and outputs. Currently I'm using the original serial cable, but in the future the [product_name] will need to be located further from the computer. Can RS422/485 converters be used? Is it necessary to use a communication module? If so, which one is recommended?

Hello, [company_name] does not recommend extending the length of the programming cable. You may try, but if you experience communication interruptions, it could lead to issues. Another option is to use analog modems; set up analog telephone stations with multiple analog phone connections. By connecting two analog modems to separate phone numbers, you can use the modem wizard within [product_name] to connect them, then attempt communication and check if it works. Alternatively, the KNX/EIB bus may be viable. On the [product_name] side you'll need the [product_name] communication module. For programming KNX/EIB, you'll require the ETS4 software and a PC tool (such as a KNX OPC-Server). The choice ultimately depends on your infrastructure and how far the cable needs to run. Hope this helps.

Hello [user_name], I suggest another solution—consider budget versus effort. One approach is to use analog modems, which is likely inexpensive but may require additional setup and testing. Alternatively, upgrade to a newer [product_name] connected via Ethernet to your PC; while costlier, it requires less effort and allows future expansion with multiple [product_name] slave modules. For details on maximum Ethernet cable lengths, see [url]. Does this help as well?

analysis.insight_summary: Users want reliable long-distance serial communication with the [product_name] ([article_no]/old version). There is uncertainty about supported options and worries about unreliable results with serial cable extensions. Suggestions include analog modems and upgrading to newer Ethernet-enabled hardware. The main challenge is identifying a simple, cost-effective solution compatible with legacy modules.
analysis.user_expectations: User seeks a reliable way to monitor the [product_name] remotely over long distances, ideally without expensive hardware upgrades or complicated setups.
